atoms.b: An important part of stories is the point of view of the person telling the story. We call this person the ((++narrator author)).
Stories can be told in ((++first_person second_person)) or in ((++third_person fourth_person)).
((++First Third)) person means that the story is told from the main ((++character’s actor’s)) point of view. When a story is in first person, the pronoun 'I' is often used.
((++Third First)) person is when an ((++invisible visible)) storyteller is describing the story.
